title: Multiscale flows and self-organisation in living matter
about: ICTS-TIFR hosts the discussion meeting 'Multiscale flows and self-organisation in living matter' from 1 to 6 March 2027 at ICTS Bengaluru. Applications are made through the ICTS registration site; the application deadline is 15 February 2027.
card_alt: Card for 'Multiscale flows and self-organisation in living matter', a discussion meeting at the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS-TIFR) in Bengaluru, India, applications due 15 Feb 2027. The photo shows the Taj Mahal in Agra, India, not Bengaluru.
